name: The Divinities Between Us
source:
Your peaceful childhood with your close friend Arabella was ripped away from you many years ago, when the neighboring kingdom declared war. Then, when Arabella was suddenly blessed by the Divinities with holy power, all sense of normalcy stripped away.

But you've been by her side all this time, and that's not about to change. And soon, this war will end, and you can finally put it all behind you.

[From [url=https://emilyi.itch.io/the-divinities-between-us]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
许多年前，当邻国宣战时，你与亲密朋友阿拉贝拉的平静童年就被夺走了。然后，当阿拉贝拉突然被神灵赐予神圣力量时，一切正常的感觉都被剥夺了。

但你一直在她身边，这一点不会改变。很快，这场战争就会结束，你终于可以把这一切抛在脑后了。

[来自[url=https://emilyi.itch.io/the-divinities-between-us]Itch.io[/url]]
